content:
Iris K: Morning team 8:03am PT  Received invoice INV-2026-342 from BlueRiver Tech for $19,980. Invoice header shows vendor name 'Blue River Technologies LLC' but our Coupa vendor is 'BlueRiver Technologies, Inc'. Also no PO visible on the PDF. PDF link: https://s3.company/blueriver/INV-2026-342.pdf
Noah D: Coupa lookup: PO 123450 exists for BlueRiver (analytics pilot) and is still OPEN with $5k remaining. PO 123450 was raised under legal name 'BlueRiver Technologies, Inc'.
Priya M: Policy requires vendor legal name or EIN to match to PO for auto-match. Two options: (1) ask vendor to reissue with the exact legal name as on Coupa or (2) vendor provides W-9 / EIN confirmation so procurement can approve manual match.
Iris K: Business says this is the final pilot invoice and they need it cleared to avoid service interruption. Marco, can you confirm the spend?
Marco L: Confirmed  this is the final invoice for the pilot project. Team needs this paid to onboard data connectors. I'm ok with match if procurement confirms identity.
procurement-bot: Suggested action: request vendor reissue with Coupa legal name OR provide W-9/EIN that matches vendor record. PO 123450 status: OPEN. Last_activity: 2026-01-12.
invoices-bot: Invoice INV-2026-342 uploaded to NetSuite. Status: "On Hold - Documentation". NS-INV-15888 created. Notified: finance-approvers.
Priya M: I'll reach out to vendor now: "Please either (A) reissue invoice INV-2026-342 using the vendor legal name 'BlueRiver Technologies, Inc' exactly as shown in Coupa, or (B) send a scanned W-9 that confirms your EIN and legal name. We need this to match to PO 123450."
Noah D: If vendor refuses, procurement can update Coupa vendor record after W-9 verification and then we can match, but that creates extra steps. Reissue preferred.
CFO - Dana: For amounts > $10k we need Director approval before payment if a manual exception is made. If vendor provides W-9 and procurement approves, route to me for one-off sign-off.
Iris K: Noted. Will wait for vendor reply. Can someone draft the GL coding in the meantime? Project GL should be 7430 (Analytics pilot).
Priya M: I'll prep coding and a short memo referencing PO 123450 and the vendor W-9 if provided.
Marco L: Vendor replied via email: "We will reissue invoice within 24 hours with legal name corrected and include PO# 123450 on header. Apologies for the mismatch."
Iris K: Great. Please ask vendor to CC finance@redwood on the reissued PDF. Once posted I'll route for Director sign-off (per CFO note).
procurement-bot: Action logged: awaiting reissued invoice. If reissued invoice includes exact Coupa legal name and PO# 123450, NetSuite will auto-match and route for approval.
invoices-bot: Update logged: NS-INV-15888 status -> Pending Reissue.
Iris K: Closing loop here once reissued invoice is attached. Leaving thread open until then. :white_check_mark:
